transfer-export.BRIEF.md:
# Accepted export slice
Implement export_csv(loans) in csv_export.py using Python standard library. It returns a CSV string, without filesystem or network effects. Keep loans.active behavior unchanged: returned_at is None means active; any other value means returned. Only active loans appear. Header, in order: loan_id,tool,due_at. Do not export borrower or other extra input fields. due_at is an opaque string or None; None is an empty cell. No overdue, timezone or reminder policy is required or authorized. Sort ascending by exact tool string, then numerical loan_id. Do not mutate input records or list order. Use proper CSV quoting; equivalent line endings are allowed. Empty input or no active loans still returns the header. Required inputs have integer loan_id, string tool, string-or-None due_at, and returned_at; arbitrary extra keys may be present. Invalid-input policy is outside this slice.

Representative legitimate record: {"loan_id": 3, "tool": "Saw, small", "due_at": null, "returned_at": null, "borrower": "Person A"}. Fields such as borrower are for the source system, not export. Stable tie ordering matters for users comparing successive exports. Future ideas: overdue highlighting and reminder delivery, pending product decisions; do not block this accepted plain export on those policies.
